thesis: Lauren Taylor Wolfe describes her career path from a sixth-grade stock competition to founding an activist hedge fund, emphasizing a philosophy of proving underestimations wrong and driving long-term value through operational efficiency and capital allocation. She details her early experience at a family office where she became excited about activism after replacing a management team at a small company, which subsequently secured major deals with Subway and Starbucks.
